subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Should the remaining Control UI zh-CN localization work land as one coordinated generated-locale update or continue as several page-specific PRs?
rationale: Current main still has hardcoded English in the reported tab surfaces, while multiple overlapping open PRs already touch generated i18n output and need maintainer direction to avoid conflicting broad translation churn.

options.title: Coordinate Existing PRs
options.body: Use the open page-specific PRs as implementation candidates, require generated-locale discipline and proof, then close this issue after the relevant PRs land.

options.title: Consolidate One Update
options.body: Pause the overlapping branches and sponsor one focused generated i18n refresh that covers the reported tabs together.

options.title: Defer Broad Completion
options.body: Keep only targeted high-impact translation fixes open and treat full Control UI localization coverage as a later product-quality pass.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Existing PRs
recommendation.body: Use the open page-specific PRs as implementation candidates, require generated-locale discipline and proof, then close this issue after the relevant PRs land.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available decision owner from the history set because the current blocker is coordination/product direction rather than one narrow page fix.
